tools.name: check_counterparty
tools.description: One call before paying, onboarding or signing with a company: register status, the warning signs shown on its Registry Pages page (insolvency, strike off, overdue filings, official lists, age), VAT number when the register has it, and its ultimate parent from GLEIF. warnings = number of checks to lo

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: Official register data for one company in any country the site covers: name, status, legal form, dates, address, activity, and the page URL to cite.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find companies by name in one country. Returns at most 10 matches with register number, place, status and page URL. Use get_company or check_counterparty next.

tools.name: get_french_company
tools.description: Official register data (INSEE Sirene) for one French company: name, status, legal form, activity, headcount band, VAT number, head office town, and the page URL to cite.

tools.name: search_french_companies
tools.description: Find French companies (legal entities) by name, optionally with the town. Returns at most 10 matches with SIREN, status and page URL. Use get_french_company for details.

tools.name: check_french_vat
tools.description: Checks the intra-EU VAT number of a French company (computed from its SIREN) against the European Commission VIES service. Returns valid or invalid, with the name and address VIES holds.

tools.name: get_uk_company
tools.description: Companies House register data for one UK company: name, status, type, incorporation date, registered office, SIC codes, accounts and confirmation statement dates, previous names, and the page URL to cite.

tools.name: search_uk_companies
tools.description: Find UK companies still on the Companies House register by name. Returns at most 10 matches with company number, postcode, status and page URL. Use get_uk_company for details.

tools.name: get_norwegian_company
tools.description: Central Coordinating Register for Legal Entities (Brønnøysund) data for one Norwegian unit: name, legal form, status, founding date, business address, industry, employees, VAT registration, and the page URL to cite.

tools.name: search_norwegian_companies
tools.description: Find Norwegian units by name. Returns at most 10 matches with organisation number, municipality, status and page URL. Use get_norwegian_company for details.
